attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The right to bear arms is an important part of the American tradition, and Americans' Second Amendment right to own and use firearms will be preserved.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The right to own firearms is subject to reasonable regulation.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"What works in Chicago may not work in Cheyenne.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for enacting and enforcing commonsense laws and improvements like closing the gun show loophole.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for improving the background check system.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for reinstating the assault weapons ban.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The goal is to prevent guns from falling into the hands of terrorists or criminals.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Acting responsibly and with respect for differing views, it is possible to both protect the constitutional right to bear arms and keep communities and children safe.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
